meta.title: Gloaming Reader — Read English works
meta.description: Read English works with on-demand lookup, translation, and saved progress.

hero.title: Read English works. Look up, translate, or ask when you need help.
hero.subtitle: Gloaming Reader keeps you in the text. Look up words, translate passages, or ask the reading assistant—without leaving the page. Your shelf saves progress so you can pick up where you left off.

origin.title: Why we built Gloaming
origin.paragraph1: Reading English often means switching to a dictionary or translator. Each lookup pulls you away from the text.
origin.paragraph2: Gloaming keeps you in the reader: open English works, look up or translate selected text, and save where you left off.

contrast.title: Reading English shouldn't require leaving the page for every word.
contrast.pastItem1: Stop to look up words and lose the thread
contrast.pastItem2: New words feel like memory chores
contrast.nextItem1: Look up, translate, or ask without leaving the page
contrast.nextItem2: Read at your own pace—no lesson plans or assignments
contrast.nextItem3: Selected text stays on screen while you look up or translate
contrast.punch: Lookup, translation, and explanation stay in the reader. No separate chat or lesson mode.

philosophy.title: Read English works with tools when you need them.
philosophy.lead: Open published English texts in the reader. Use lookup, translation, or explanation only on the passages you select.
philosophy.authenticBody: Read full English texts from the catalog—not rewritten or simplified study passages.
philosophy.focusBody: The text stays on screen. Look up or translate without switching apps or tabs.
philosophy.assistBody: Dictionary, translation, and sentence explanation open from your selection. Close them to return to reading.

product.title: Read English works with in-text lookup, translation, and explanation.
product.readerBody: Focused reading. Comfortable type. Clean layout. Less visual noise.
product.companionBody: Select text to look up a word, translate a passage, or request a sentence explanation. Results appear beside the text.
product.companionCardBody: Explains the selected sentence in context, including word meaning and how the clause fits the surrounding text.
product.shelfBody: Save what you're reading. Pick up where you left off.

friction.title: Fewer steps when a sentence is hard.
friction.lead: Lookup, translation, and explanation open from the text you are reading—without leaving the page.
friction.nextItem2: Select the sentence in the reader.
friction.nextItem3: Look up, translate, or request an explanation.

invite.title: Read English works on your shelf.
invite.body: Sign in to save progress, build your shelf, and use lookup, translation, and the reading assistant when you need help.

footer.tagline: English reading with in-text lookup, translation, and saved progress.
